Snh. 96ᵇ היכלא קליא קְלִית a burnt temple thou didst burn (v. טְחַן); a. fr.—Trnsf. to expose to the evil eye or to the covetousness of thieves.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 30a:5">B. Mets. 30ᵃ</cite> <he>דמִקְלָא קָלֵי לה וכ׳</he> (by exhibiting the found object) he exposes it to loss through the evil eye or through thieves.

senses.gloss: to be burnt. Snh. l. c. מטא … היכלא מִיקְּלֵי the time has arrived for the sanctuary to be destroyed and the Temple to be burnt.
